decisions_for_user.question: Does an-archived-agent-holds-nothing-and-is-offered-nowhere accept a hub/ui/src bundle refresh, or ship API-only?
decisions_for_user.context: WIDENED BY R2 into one decision with two halves, both the same wall (a hub/ui/src change -> make ui -> reaches the operator's live :8000 app). Half (a), found by R1: the change makes PATCH /agents/{name} refuse binding a charter to an archived agent, but the archived agent's Charter section keeps rendering CharterPicker (AgentSettingsPage.tsx:124-135) and on failure shows only its own generic 'Could not update charter binding.' -- the server's sentence is dropped, the F187 shape. Half (b), found by R2: nothing renders the archive or unarchive response AT ALL -- useArchiveAgent (hub/ui/src/api/agents.ts:214-241) is the only client of both routes and its onSuccess takes no argument, so the body is discarded. So every sentence group 2 adds (released_charter_id, the archive sentence, the unarchive standing sentence) is an API fact no operator can read, and the operator's own rider ('unarchive must then say the bindings are gone') is only half discharged. The change is complete and shippable without either half.
options: accept the bundle refresh and do both halves (disable the picker + surface the server detail; render what archive/unarchive say)
accept the bundle refresh for half (a) only
ship API-only and file both halves as their own findings
